sentences.en: For decades, the Federal Aviation Administration had strict rules around the mental health of pilots.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，美国联邦航空管理局对飞行员的心理健康有着严格的规定。

sentences.en: Pilots who were diagnosed with any kind of mental health disorder, like depression, were not allowed to fly.
sentences.zh: 被诊断出患有任何心理健康疾病（如抑郁症）的飞行员是不被允许飞行的。

sentences.en: Almost half of all Americans will experience mental illness at some point in their lifetime.
sentences.zh: 几乎一半的美国人在其一生中的某个阶段都会经历精神疾病。

sentences.en: So why would pilots working in one of the most demanding, isolating occupations be any different?
sentences.zh: 那么，在要求最高、最孤立的职业之一工作的飞行员又怎么会例外呢？

sentences.en: Every single pilot I interviewed for my New York Times magazine story had withheld some kind of underlying medical issue or knew of a colleague who did
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报杂志》报道采访过的每一位飞行员，都隐瞒了某种潜在的健康问题，或者知道有同事这么做过

sentences.en: because they knew it was likely they would be out of work for months, maybe even years, if they had to go through the FAA's special certification process for medical conditions.
sentences.zh: 因为他们知道，如果不得不经历联邦航空管理局针对健康状况的特殊认证流程，他们很可能会失业数月甚至数年。

sentences.en: And the FAA might even conclude that a diagnosis would be caused to ground the pilot.
sentences.zh: 而且联邦航空管理局甚至可能断定，确诊将成为将该飞行员停飞的理由。

sentences.en: So what I really wanted to dive into was, is the FAA so rigorous that it's making it less safe to fly?
sentences.zh: 所以我真正想深入探究的是：联邦航空管理局是不是过于严格，反而让飞行变得不那么安全了？

sentences.en: Troy Merritt, a pilot for a major U.S.
sentences.zh: 特洛伊·梅里特是美国一家主流

sentences.en: airline, returned from his 30th birthday trip in Croatia in October 2022.
sentences.zh: 航空公司的飞行员，于2022年10月结束了在克罗地亚的30岁生日旅行归来。

sentences.en: Sailing on a catamaran, eating great food, socializing with friends, and cried.
sentences.zh: 在双体船上航行，品尝美食，与朋友社交，然后哭了。

sentences.en: This wasn't back-to-work blues, but collapsed on the floor, full-body-shaking misery.
sentences.zh: 这不是复工的郁闷，而是瘫倒在地、全身颤抖的痛苦。

sentences.en: When he wasn't crying, he slept.
sentences.zh: 不哭的时候，他就睡觉。

sentences.en: I've got to find a therapist, he told himself.
sentences.zh: 我得找个心理治疗师，他告诉自己。

sentences.en: And he did.
sentences.zh: 他也确实这么做了。

sentences.en: Quickly.
sentences.zh: 很快。

sentences.en: If that therapist didn't write down depression,
sentences.zh: 如果那个治疗师没有写下抑郁症，

sentences.en: Merritt would be okay.
sentences.zh: 梅里特就没事。

sentences.en: He could still fly planes, keep his job, as long as he wasn't diagnosed with a mental illness.
sentences.zh: 只要他没有被诊断出患有精神疾病，他就可以继续开飞机，保住工作。

sentences.en: After several sessions, the therapist gently suggested that he might need medication.
sentences.zh: 经过几次面谈后，治疗师温和地建议他可能需要药物治疗。

sentences.en: Merritt adamantly refused.
sentences.zh: 梅里特坚决拒绝。

sentences.en: The therapist never raised the subject again.
sentences.zh: 治疗师再也没有提起这个话题。

sentences.en: Merritt's husband, also an airline pilot, hoped he would break out of this funk.
sentences.zh: 梅里特的丈夫也是一名航空公司飞行员，他希望他能走出这种低谷。

sentences.en: Let's go for a hike, he would say.
sentences.zh: 我们去徒步吧，他会这么说。

sentences.en: We live in California.
sentences.zh: 我们住在加利福尼亚。

sentences.en: It's a gorgeous day.
sentences.zh: 天气好极了。

sentences.en: But Merritt wouldn't get up off the floor.
sentences.zh: 但梅里特就是不肯从地板上起来。

sentences.en: I don't know what to do,
sentences.zh: 我不知道该怎么办，

sentences.en: Merritt sometimes mumbled.
sentences.zh: 梅里特有时会嘟囔着。

sentences.en: Other times it seemed as if he were in a coma.
sentences.zh: 有时他看起来就像陷入了昏迷。

sentences.en: His husband worried about going to work and leaving Merritt alone at home.
sentences.zh: 他的丈夫担心去上班把梅里特一个人留在家里。

sentences.en: But when Merritt was at work, flying planes, he was much better, focused on the tasks in front of him.
sentences.zh: 但当梅里特在工作、驾驶飞机时，他的状态要好得多，专注于眼前的工作。

sentences.en: It was when he reached his destination city and tried to settle into a strange hotel room that loneliness and sadness crept over him again.
sentences.zh: 每当他到达目的地城市，试图在一个陌生的酒店房间里安顿下来时，孤独和悲伤就会再次向他袭来。

sentences.en: Coworkers didn't seem to notice because he was often flying with different crews.
sentences.zh: 同事们似乎没有注意到，因为他经常与不同的机组人员一起飞行。

sentences.en: Later that autumn,
sentences.zh: 那年秋天晚些时候，

sentences.en: Merritt slipped into extraordinary darkness.
sentences.zh: 梅里特陷入了一种异乎寻常的黑暗之中。

sentences.en: Crying became more frequent, the bouts less predictable.
sentences.zh: 哭泣变得更加频繁，发作也更加没有规律。

sentences.en: Whenever he tried to leave the house, his breathing grew shallow, his fingers numb.
sentences.zh: 每当他试图出门时，呼吸就会变浅，手指发麻。

sentences.en: When do I get medication?
sentences.zh: 我什么时候才能吃药？

sentences.en: He asked his husband.
sentences.zh: 他问他的丈夫。

sentences.en: Do I do that now?
sentences.zh: 我现在该这么做吗？

sentences.en: That's a big, big lever to pull, his husband replied.
sentences.zh: 那是很大很大的一步，他的丈夫回答道。

sentences.en: It was a big lever to pull.
sentences.zh: 这确实是很大的一步。

sentences.en: Merritt, like all pilots, knew that if he was formally diagnosed with a mental health condition, he might never fly a plane again.
sentences.zh: 梅里特和所有飞行员一样，知道如果自己被正式诊断出患有心理健康状况，他可能永远无法再驾驶飞机。

sentences.en: Pilots and air traffic controllers must be deemed medically fit by the Federal Aviation Administration through a certification process, one that is particularly arduous
sentences.zh: 飞行员和空中交通管制员必须由美国联邦航空管理局通过认证程序认定为身体状况合格，这一程序尤其艰难，

sentences.en: when it involves mental health diagnoses.
sentences.zh: 特别是涉及心理健康诊断时。

sentences.en: Merritt feared that what was best for his health might not satisfy the FAA's idea of public safety.
sentences.zh: 梅里特担心，对他健康最有利的事情可能无法满足联邦航空管理局对公共安全的设想。

sentences.en: Certain medications are disqualifying, for instance, even when recommended by a treating psychiatriSt.
sentences.zh: 例如，某些药物是取消资格的条件，即使是经主治精神科医生推荐也是如此。

sentences.en: Like a lot of pilots,
sentences.zh: 就像许多飞行员一样，

sentences.en: Merritt stayed silent.
sentences.zh: 梅里特选择保持沉默。

sentences.en: He hoped therapy would be enough.
sentences.zh: 他希望心理治疗就足够了。

sentences.en: Because he felt okay at work, and even outside work every now and again, there seemed to be a chance he would get better.
sentences.zh: 因为他在工作中感觉还不错，甚至偶尔在工作之外也感觉不错，所以似乎还有康复的希望。

sentences.en: Then, one night in December that year,
sentences.zh: 然后，那年12月的一个晚上，

sentences.en: Merritt was at home by himself when the realization hit him.
sentences.zh: 梅里特独自在家时，突然意识到了一件事。

sentences.en: Suicide had become an option.
sentences.zh: 自杀成了一种选择。

sentences.en: He did not consider it outright, but he felt as if someone were now showing it to him as a possibility, one that had never existed before.
sentences.zh: 他并没有直接考虑自杀，但他觉得好像有人现在把它作为一个可能性展示给自己，而这个可能性以前从未存在过。

sentences.en: The next morning,
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，

sentences.en: Merritt couldn't make himself go to work.
sentences.zh: 梅里特怎么也无法让自己去上班。

sentences.en: He called his husband and told him,
sentences.zh: 他打电话给丈夫告诉他，

sentences.en: It's time.
sentences.zh: 时候到了。

sentences.en: It's not hard to see why authorities take such a cautious approach to mental illness.
sentences.zh: 不难看出为什么当局对精神疾病采取如此谨慎的态度。

sentences.en: When a suicidal pilot has intentionally crashed a passenger plane, the ramifications have perhaps been felt even more deeply than after other aviation disasters.
sentences.zh: 当一名有自杀倾向的飞行员蓄意撞毁客机时，其带来的影响或许比其他航空灾难更加深远。

sentences.en: The anger at regulators more intense.
sentences.zh: 对监管机构的愤怒更加强烈。

sentences.en: The media attention more outsize.
sentences.zh: 媒体的关注更加空前。

sentences.en: A fatal Germanwings flight in 2015, probably the most infamous such incident, continues to affect policy to this day.
sentences.zh: 2015年德翼航空的致命航班或许是此类事件中最臭名昭著的，至今仍对政策产生影响。

sentences.en: An investigation by French authorities determined that the plane was deliberately flown into a mountainside in the French Alps, causing 150 deaths
sentences.zh: 法国当局的调查确定，该飞机被蓄意撞向法国阿尔卑斯山的山腰，造成150人死亡，

sentences.en: by a pilot who had been treated for depression and who previously held a medical certificate from the FAA.
sentences.zh: 肇事飞行员曾接受过抑郁症治疗，此前曾持有联邦航空管理局颁发的体检合格证。

sentences.en: While such events are exceedingly rare, it is quite likely that pilots have caused other crashes on purpose.
sentences.zh: 虽然此类事件极为罕见，但很有可能飞行员曾蓄意造成过其他坠机事故。

sentences.en: In response to the Germanwings tragedy,
sentences.zh: 为回应德翼航空的悲剧，

sentences.en: Senator Dianne Feinstein commissioned a report from the Inspector General's office at the Department of Transportation.
sentences.zh: 参议员黛安·范斯坦委托交通部总监察长办公室撰写了一份报告。

sentences.en: Eight years later, its findings were finally released.
sentences.zh: 八年后，调查结果终于公布。

sentences.en: Despite the FAA's comprehensive certification process, the agency's ability to mitigate safety risks is limited by pilots' reluctance to disclose mental health conditions.
sentences.zh: 尽管联邦航空管理局拥有全面的认证程序，但该机构减轻安全风险的能力受到飞行员不愿披露心理健康状况的限制。

sentences.en: In an effort to get pilots and air traffic controllers the mental health treatment they need, and keep aviation safe,
sentences.zh: 为了让飞行员和空中交通管制员获得他们所需的心理健康治疗并保障航空安全，

sentences.en: Congress introduced the Mental Health and Aviation Act in September.
sentences.zh: 国会在9月提出了《心理健康与航空法案》。

sentences.en: The legislation, which would relax some restrictions, is part of an ongoing debate over how best to manage mental health in a profession where split-second decision-making
sentences.zh: 这项将放宽某些限制的立法，是关于如何在分秒必争的决策

sentences.en: can mean the difference between life and death.
sentences.zh: 可能意味着生死之别的职业中最好地管理心理健康的持续辩论的一部分。

sentences.en: The issue was touched on in remarks made by President Trump in late January, the day after a Black Hawk helicopter collided with a passenger plane in Washington, killing 67.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统在1月下旬的一番讲话中提到了这个问题，当时正值一架黑鹰直升机在华盛顿与一架客机相撞、造成67人死亡的第二天。

sentences.en: You have to go by psychological quality,
sentences.zh: 你必须看心理素质，

sentences.en: Trump said, seemingly in reference to the FAA's standards for airline pilots and air traffic controllers.
sentences.zh: 特朗普说，这似乎是指联邦航空管理局对航空公司飞行员和空中交通管制员的标准。

sentences.en: No evidence so far has suggested that mental health was a factor in the collision.
sentences.zh: 迄今为止没有任何证据表明心理健康是此次相撞事故的一个因素。

sentences.en: The debate is now unfolding at a moment of upheaval for the FAA.
sentences.zh: 这场辩论正值联邦航空管理局动荡之际展开。

sentences.en: Its director,
sentences.zh: 其局长

sentences.en: Michael Whitaker, has resigned, and an acting director has been in place since Trump returned to the White House.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·惠特克已辞职，自特朗普重返白宫以来，一直由代理局长代行职责。

sentences.en: Last month, the administration fired close to 400 FAA workers, and the aviation industry is already facing serious shortages.
sentences.zh: 上个月，政府解雇了近400名联邦航空管理局员工，而航空业已经面临严重的短缺。

sentences.en: More than 90% of air traffic control facilities today are understaffed, and according to some estimates, the United States could be short as many as 30,000 pilots
sentences.zh: 如今超过90%的空中交通管制设施人手不足，据一些估计，美国在未来五年内

sentences.en: in the next five years.
sentences.zh: 可能会短缺多达30,000名飞行员。

sentences.en: Though flight safety has been at an all-time high in recent years, a deadly crash like the one in Washington inevitably draws increased media attention to near misses
sentences.zh: 尽管近年来飞行安全处于历史最高水平，但像华盛顿那样致命的坠机事故不可避免地会吸引更多媒体对险些相撞事件的关注，

sentences.en: and makes people more nervous about flying.
sentences.zh: 并让人对飞行更加感到焦虑。

sentences.en: Perhaps most concerning, those near misses seem to be on the rise.
sentences.zh: 或许最令人担忧的是，这些险些相撞的事件似乎在增加。

sentences.en: According to a 2023 investigation by the New York Times, there were 300 near collisions of commercial planes over a 12-month period.
sentences.zh: 根据《纽约时报》2023年的一项调查，在12个月内发生了300起商用飞机险些相撞的事件。

sentences.en: When Jennifer Homendy, the chair of the
sentences.zh: 当国家运输安全委员会

sentences.en: National Transportation Safety Board, testified that year before Congress about their significance, she said, any one of them could have meant lives lost, a warning that has since
sentences.zh: 主席詹妮弗·霍门迪当年就其重要性在国会作证时，她表示，其中任何一起都可能意味着生命的丧失，这一警告此后在华盛顿致命坠机事件发生后

sentences.en: proved prescient after the fatal crash in Washington.
sentences.zh: 被证明是有先见之明的。

sentences.en: Close calls may stem from factors beyond pilots' control, but their swift responses are critical to avoid catastrophe.
sentences.zh: 千钧一发的险情可能源于飞行员无法控制的因素，但他们迅速的反应对于避免灾难至关重要。

sentences.en: When something goes wrong, they need to be at their beSt.
sentences.zh: 当出现问题时，他们必须处于最佳状态。

sentences.en: It's the issues like Germanwings that kind of shock the world about the importance of pilot mental health.
sentences.zh: 正是像德翼航空这样轰动世界的问题，才凸显了飞行员心理健康的重要性。

sentences.en: Gregory Kirk, a psychiatrist who evaluates pilots, told me.
sentences.zh: 评估飞行员的精神科医生格雷戈里·柯克告诉我。

sentences.en: But the far more mundane risk is a pilot who has an untreated or poorly treated mental health condition that, as a result, may have difficulty in a complex threat environment.
sentences.zh: 但更常见、更平淡的风险是一名飞行员患有未得到治疗或治疗不当的精神健康状况，因此在复杂的威胁环境中可能会遇到困难。

sentences.en: Like the situation in which airline pilots found themselves before the collision with the Black Hawk helicopter, or the one
sentences.zh: 就像航空公司飞行员在与黑鹰直升机相撞前所处的情况，或者

sentences.en: Chelsea Sullenberger faced when a flock of geese disabled his plane's engines.
sentences.zh: 切利·萨伦伯格在鸟群导致其飞机发动机失效时所面对的情况。

sentences.en: Sullenberger landed it on the Hudson River, saving all 155 people aboard the flight.
sentences.zh: 萨伦伯格将飞机降落在哈德逊河上，挽救了机上所有155人的生命。

sentences.en: Every airline pilot and controller must go through the FAA's medical certification process at least once a year.
sentences.zh: 每位航空公司飞行员和管制员必须每年至少通过一次联邦航空管理局的医疗认证程序。

sentences.en: This requires that an aviation medical examiner, a physician who has completed a four-and-a-half-day training seminar with the FAA, reviews a pilot's medical history
sentences.zh: 这要求航空体检医生（完成了联邦航空管理局为期四天半的培训研讨会的医师）审查飞行员的病史

sentences.en: and performs a physical.
sentences.zh: 并进行体检。

sentences.en: Pilots age 40 and over undergo this process every six months, as do those with certain health conditions that also require additional tests and clearance from specialists.
sentences.zh: 40岁及以上的飞行员每六个月经历一次此过程，患有某些健康状况需要额外检查和专科医生批准的人也是如此。

sentences.en: But few certification pathways, if any, are considered more complex or take longer than the one for mental illness.
sentences.zh: 但几乎没有什么认证途径能比精神疾病的认证途径更复杂或耗时更长。

sentences.en: Pilots are taught early, by those who went before them, by those around them, that being honest with the FAA about any aspect of their medical history can jeopardize their careers.
sentences.zh: 前辈和身边的同行很早就教导飞行员：向联邦航空管理局如实告知他们病史的任何方面都可能危及他们的职业生涯。

sentences.en: Several years ago, an investigation by the Department of Veterans Affairs that cross-checked
sentences.zh: 几年前，退伍军人事务部的一项调查交叉比对

sentences.en: VA and FAA databases revealed a wide discrepancy.
sentences.zh: 了退伍军人事务部和联邦航空管理局的数据库，结果显示出巨大的差异。

sentences.en: Around 4,800 commercial and airline pilots were receiving
sentences.zh: 大约4,800名商业和航空公司飞行员在领取

sentences.en: VA disability benefits without reporting these medical issues to the FAA.
sentences.zh: 退伍军人事务部残疾福利，却没有向联邦航空管理局报告这些医疗问题。

sentences.en: While some of those pilots may have been fraudulently collecting benefits for non-existent or exaggerated problems, others were found to have conditions that should have
sentences.zh: 虽然其中一些飞行员可能是通过欺诈手段为不存在或夸大的问题领取福利，但其他人则被发现患有本应使他们

sentences.en: grounded them.
sentences.zh: 停飞的疾病。

sentences.en: Unreported health disorders can be deadly.
sentences.zh: 未报告的健康失调可能是致命的。

sentences.en: A study of 202 fatal aviation accidents that occurred in the United States in 2015 found that in 5% of the cases, pilots had not disclosed the diagnoses or medications
sentences.zh: 对2015年在美国发生的202起致命航空事故的一项研究发现，在5%的案例中，飞行员没有披露后来被证实与坠机有关的诊断结果或药物，

sentences.en: that were later implicated in the crash, most commonly including psychiatric drugs of some sort, whether taken by prescription or recreationally.
sentences.zh: 其中最常见的是某种精神类药物，无论是处方药还是娱乐性药物。

sentences.en: Every pilot I interviewed for this article knew of colleagues who had hidden their medical issues from the FAA.
sentences.zh: 我为这篇文章采访过的每一位飞行员都知道有同事向联邦航空管理局隐瞒了他们的医疗问题。

sentences.en: Some admitted to doing so themselves, several of whom told me that their supervisors had urged them not to report a health problem.
sentences.zh: 一些人承认自己也这么做过，其中几人告诉我，他们的主管曾敦促他们不要上报健康问题。

sentences.en: And then there are the pilots who simply do not seek medical attention.
sentences.zh: 还有一些飞行员根本不寻求医疗帮助。

sentences.en: A 2022 survey of pilots in the United States found that 56% of them reported having avoided health care in some way.
sentences.zh: 2022年对美国飞行员的一项调查发现，56%的人报告曾以某种方式回避医疗保健。

sentences.en: Because pilots are often reluctant to seek medical care or disclose health concerns, the number of those who are struggling with mental illness, a condition that is
sentences.zh: 由于飞行员往往不愿寻求医疗护理或披露健康问题，那些正与心理疾病（这种疾病比许多其他病症往往更容易隐藏、也更难坦白）作斗争的人数

sentences.en: often easier to hide and harder to be open about than many other ailments, remains unknown.
sentences.zh: 仍然是个未知数。

sentences.en: A 2016 survey of airline pilots found that nearly
sentences.zh: 2016年对航空公司飞行员的一项调查发现，近

sentences.en: 13% of them met the criteria for a diagnosis of depression, and more than 4% had suicidal thoughts in the preceding two weeks.
sentences.zh: 13%的人符合抑郁症诊断标准，超过4%的人在过去两周内有过自杀想法。

sentences.en: The pandemic, which forced pilots into furloughs and upon return into facing more unruly passengers, probably made things worse, as it has for the general population.
sentences.zh: 大流行迫使飞行员休假，并在返回后面临更多不守规矩的乘客，这可能让情况变得更糟，对普通大众来说也是如此。

sentences.en: Almost half of Americans will experience mental illness at some point in their lifetime.
sentences.zh: 几乎一半的美国人在其一生中的某个阶段都会经历精神疾病。

sentences.en: There's no reason to think pilots are spared.
sentences.zh: 没有理由认为飞行员能幸免。

sentences.en: If anything, given their schedules, their irregular sleep, and all the time they spend away from home and family,
sentences.zh: 鉴于他们的排班、不规律的睡眠以及所有远离家人和离开家的时间，

sentences.en: it would be little surprise if they don't fare worse.
sentences.zh: 如果他们的状况没有更糟糕的话，那倒真令人意外了。

sentences.en: For more than half a century, the FAA essentially barred anyone known to have a mental health disorder from piloting a plane.
sentences.zh: 半个多世纪以来，联邦航空管理局基本上禁止任何已知患有精神健康障碍的人驾驶飞机。

sentences.en: Then in 2010, the FAA began allowing pilots with depression or anxiety into the cockpit on a strict case-by-case basis if, after a monitoring period, no shorter than 12 months
sentences.zh: 然后在2010年，美国联邦航空管理局开始允许患有抑郁症或焦虑症的飞行员在严格的个案评估基础上进入驾驶舱，前提是经过一段不少于12个月的监测期

sentences.en: that begins when they start one of four designated psychiatric medications they are considered to be stable.
sentences.zh: 这段监测期从他们开始服用四种指定的精神科药物之一时算起，被认为病情稳定。

sentences.en: Though the minimum monitoring period is now six months and the list of medications has since expanded to eight, many pilots are still withholding their symptoms,
sentences.zh: 尽管现在的最短监测期已缩短至六个月，药物清单也已扩大到八种，但许多飞行员仍然隐瞒症状，

sentences.en: reluctant to seek help and go through the FAA's onerous certification process around mental health.
sentences.zh: 不愿寻求帮助并经历美国联邦航空管理局繁琐的精神健康认证流程。

sentences.en: The hypothetical dangers of a system that makes pilots hesitant to disclose their mental health symptoms became frighteningly real one Sunday evening in October 2023.
sentences.zh: 2023年10月的一个星期日晚上，一个让飞行员对公开精神健康症状感到犹豫的系统所带来的假设性危险，变得真实得令人毛骨悚然。

sentences.en: Joseph Emerson, an off-duty captain for Alaska Airlines, was returning from a guy's trip in rural Washington.
sentences.zh: 约瑟夫·埃默森是阿拉斯加航空公司的一名休班机长，当时正从华盛顿州农村地区的一次男子旅行中返回。

sentences.en: To get home more quickly to his wife and two sons in the Bay Area, he took a jump seat in the cockpit, available only to those who, even if off-duty, are qualified
sentences.zh: 为了更快地赶回湾区与妻子和两个儿子团聚，他坐在驾驶舱的跳椅上，这个座位只提供给那些即使在休班时也具备资格的人

sentences.en: to provide assistance in emergencies.
sentences.zh: 在紧急情况下提供协助。

sentences.en: Emerson chatted with the crew about the aircraft and the weather before cramming his six-foot frame into the jump seat.
sentences.zh: 埃默森在将他六英尺高的身躯塞进跳椅之前，曾与机组人员聊起飞机和天气。

sentences.en: As the plane took off, he felt himself separating from reality.
sentences.zh: 当飞机起飞时，他感到自己正在脱离现实。

sentences.en: You need to wake up.
sentences.zh: 你需要醒来。

sentences.en: You're not going home.
sentences.zh: 你回不了家了。

sentences.en: This isn't real.
sentences.zh: 这不是真的。

sentences.en: Looped through his thoughts like a drumbeat, he says.
sentences.zh: 这些念头像鼓点一样在他的思绪中循环往复，他说。

sentences.en: I'm not okay, he told the other pilots.
sentences.zh: 我状态不对，他告诉其他飞行员。

sentences.en: He then pulled the two bright red handles in the cockpit that cut the plane's fuel supply in emergencies, turning it into a glider.
sentences.zh: 随后，他拉下了驾驶舱内两个亮红色的手柄，这两个手柄会在紧急情况下切断飞机的燃油供应，使飞机变成滑翔机。

sentences.en: To the passengers, the plane seemed to nosedive.
sentences.zh: 对乘客来说，飞机似乎呈俯冲状下降。

sentences.en: After the pilots wrestled Emerson away, he left the cockpit, and they locked the door behind him.
sentences.zh: 在飞行员合力将埃默森拉开后，他离开了驾驶舱，他们随即将门从里面反锁。

sentences.en: He walked to the back of the plane and grabbed an emergency exit door handle.
sentences.zh: 他走到飞机后部，抓住了紧急出口门的把手。

sentences.en: A flight attendant put her hand on his, stopping him.
sentences.zh: 一名乘务员把手叠在他的手上，阻止了他。

sentences.en: Another flight attendant heard him say he had just tried to kill everybody.
sentences.zh: 另一名乘务员听到他说他刚才试图杀死所有人。

sentences.en: The plane diverted to Portland, Oregon, where Emerson was arrested.
sentences.zh: 飞机改道飞往俄勒冈州波特兰市，埃默森在那里被捕。

sentences.en: If I was operating in reality, if I understood how unsafe I was, there's no way
sentences.zh: 如果我当时在现实中运作，如果我明白自己有多不安全，我是绝对不可能

sentences.en: I'm getting on that flight that day in a jump seat,
sentences.zh: 在那天坐上那架航班的跳椅的，

sentences.en: Emerson told me recently.
sentences.zh: 埃默森最近对我说。

sentences.en: He has sought therapy on and off for years, and at one point a therapist suggested he start on antidepressants.
sentences.zh: 他多年来断断续续地寻求心理治疗，曾有一位治疗师建议他开始服用抗抑郁药。

sentences.en: Emerson refused, afraid of losing his job.
sentences.zh: 埃默森拒绝了，因为害怕失去工作。

sentences.en: But after the sudden death of his best friend in 2018, he often seemed sad, maybe depressed, so one day his wife,
sentences.zh: 但在2018年挚友突然去世后，他经常显得悲伤，也许是抑郁了，于是在有一天，他的妻子

sentences.en: Sarah Stretch, also raised the subject of medication.
sentences.zh: 莎拉·斯特雷奇也提出了用药的话题。

sentences.en: A big argument followed.
sentences.zh: 随之而来的是一场大争吵。

sentences.en: He reminded her that without his job they wouldn't be able to afford their mortgage.
sentences.zh: 他提醒她，如果没有了这份工作，他们将无力支付房贷。

sentences.en: I learned early on in our relationship that I would never ask him not to fly, she told me.
sentences.zh: 我在我们关系初期就明白，我永远不会要求他不要飞行，她对我说。

sentences.en: Emerson instead medicated himself with alcohol.
sentences.zh: 埃默森转而用酒精来麻痹自己。

sentences.en: What most likely triggered his episode that evening was the hallucinogenic mushrooms he had consumed two days before the flight.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上引发他发作的最可能原因，是他在航班起飞前两天食用的致幻蘑菇。

sentences.en: The weekend with his buddies had been a tribute to his best friend.
sentences.zh: 与哥们儿度过的那个周末是对他挚友的一种悼念。

sentences.en: Emerson, still grieving, tried the mushrooms because, he says, he just wanted to feel better.
sentences.zh: 仍在悲痛中的埃默森尝试了蘑菇，因为他说，他只是想感觉好一点。

sentences.en: His case was a wake-up call for the industry.
sentences.zh: 他的案例为整个行业敲响了警钟。

sentences.en: Renewed scrutiny was directed at the FAA's medical certification process, and the National
sentences.zh: 人们对美国联邦航空管理局的医疗认证流程进行了重新审视，国家

sentences.en: Transportation Safety Board was prompted to convene a mental health safety summit.
sentences.zh: 运输安全委员会也促成了召开一次精神健康安全峰会。

sentences.en: Because a pilot's work is safety sensitive, they are held to a higher standard.
sentences.zh: 因为飞行员的工作对安全高度敏感，所以他们受到更高标准的要求。

sentences.en: Susan Northrup, the FAA's flight surgeon since 2021, told me in an email.
sentences.zh: 自2021年起担任美国联邦航空管理局航空医官的苏珊·诺思拉普在一封电子邮件中对我说。

sentences.en: Her duty is to safeguard the broader flying public, she added, which supersedes the needs of individual pilots.
sentences.zh: 她补充说，她的职责是保障广大飞行公众的安全，这高于个别飞行员的需求。

sentences.en: The worry, though, is that the FAA has inadvertently created a mental health process so burdensome and restrictive that it deters pilots like Emerson from being honest
sentences.zh: 不过，令人担忧的是，美国联邦航空管理局无意中创建了一个过于繁琐和限制性的精神健康流程，以至于阻碍了像埃默森这样的飞行员向

sentences.en: with authorities and seeking help when they need it.
sentences.zh: 当局坦白并在需要时寻求帮助。

sentences.en: Homendy, the NTSB chair, told me that a system that drives pilots to hide any symptoms of mental illness is a detriment to safety.
sentences.zh: 美国国家运输安全委员会主席霍门迪对我说，一个迫使飞行员隐藏任何精神疾病症状的系统是对安全的危害。

sentences.en: Still, despite what recent headlines might suggest, commercial aviation is remarkably safe.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，正如最近的头条新闻所暗示的那样，商业航空出奇地安全。

sentences.en: Statistically speaking, passengers are far more likely to die in a car accident on the way to the airport than from a plane crash.
sentences.zh: 从统计学上讲，乘客在去机场的路上死于车祸的可能性，远大于死于飞机失事。

sentences.en: That track record isn't just a function of medical screening.
sentences.zh: 这一记录不仅仅是医疗筛查的结果。

sentences.en: Policies like requiring at least two pilots to be on duty during flights offer essential protections.
sentences.zh: 诸如要求飞行期间至少有两名飞行员在岗等政策提供了必要的保障。

sentences.en: In such a reliable system, loosening mental health restrictions might not lead to any perceptible decline in safety.
sentences.zh: 在这样一个可靠的系统中，放宽精神健康限制可能不会导致安全出现任何明显的下降。

sentences.en: It might even improve safety by getting more pilots to seek treatment.
sentences.zh: 它甚至可能通过促使更多飞行员寻求治疗来提高安全性。

sentences.en: But the aviation industry in the United States has long operated on the assumption that the only way to ensure safety is to have a stringent, inflexible approach
sentences.zh: 但长期以来，美国的航空业一直基于这样一种假设：确保安全的唯一途径是对医疗认证采取

sentences.en: to medical certification.
sentences.zh: 严格且不灵活的方法。

sentences.en: It seems to have worked.
sentences.zh: 这似乎起作用了。

sentences.en: Do we really want to disrupt it?
sentences.zh: 我们真的想要打破它吗？

sentences.zh: 我是温纳洛。

sentences.en: I write the game
sentences.zh: 我编写了游戏

sentences.en: Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games, and I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 《Connections》，这是《纽约时报》游戏中的谜题之一，我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog, and I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗，我也喜欢试图捉弄你。

sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖尔斯基，我每天都制作

sentences.en: Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做联觉的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 当我听音乐时我能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由真人制作的，就像你刚刚听到声音的那些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com 杠 games，今天就开始游玩。

sentences.en: After Merritt called his husband, he had to tell his airline that he needed to go on medical leave.
sentences.zh: 在梅里特给丈夫打电话后，他不得不告诉航空公司自己需要请病假。

sentences.en: He didn't explain why.
sentences.zh: 他没有解释原因。

sentences.en: A few weeks later, a psychiatrist started him on an antidepressant.
sentences.zh: 几周后，一位精神科医生开始让他服用抗抑郁药。

sentences.en: His symptoms improved, faster and more significantly than he had hoped.
sentences.zh: 他的症状有所改善，比他希望的速度更快、程度更显著。

sentences.en: He was even surprised to find himself enjoying a music festival with new friends, a situation that would have made him too nervous in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 他甚至惊讶地发现自己正在和新朋友一起享受音乐节，这种情况在过去会让他过于紧张。

sentences.en: Two months after starting the medication, he felt much better than he had in years.
sentences.zh: 开始服药两个月后，他感觉比多年来的任何时候都要好得多。

sentences.en: But he still had to wait out the full six months mandated by the FAA.
sentences.zh: 但他仍然必须熬过美国联邦航空管理局规定的完整六个月。

sentences.en: Then another set of evaluations began.
sentences.zh: 接着，另一轮评估开始了。

sentences.en: Merritt had to find doctors who were HIMSS specialists.
sentences.zh: 梅里特必须找到身为 HIMSS 专家的医生。

sentences.en: HIMSS stands for
sentences.zh: HIMSS 代表

sentences.en: Human Intervention
sentences.zh: 人类干预

sentences.en: Motivational Study, which was created in the 1970s and helps pilots recover from alcohol and drug abuse.
sentences.zh: 动机研究，该项目创立于20世纪70年代，旨在帮助飞行员从酒精和药物滥用中恢复。

sentences.en: It is now an industry-wide program made up of airline management, unions, specially trained doctors designated by the FAA and the FAA itself, which provides HIMSS
sentences.zh: 它现在是一个全行业项目，由航空公司管理层、工会、美国联邦航空管理局指定的接受过专门培训的医生以及美国联邦航空管理局本身组成，后者为 HIMSS

sentences.en: with about $540,000 in annual funding.
sentences.zh: 提供每年约54万美元的资金。

sentences.en: In 2010, the agency created a program,
sentences.zh: 2010年，该机构创建了一个项目，

sentences.en: Drawing on HIMSS, for pilots taking certain antidepressants.
sentences.zh: 借鉴 HIMSS 的经验，针对服用特定抗抑郁药的飞行员。

sentences.en: The agency decided that HIMSS specialists, who include psychiatrists and neuropsychologists, already had the expertise required for these assessments and could immediately
sentences.zh: 该机构决定，包括精神科医生和神经心理学家在内的 HIMSS 专家已经具备了这些评估所需的专业知识，可以立即

sentences.en: transfer their skills to evaluate pilots with mental health conditions as well.
sentences.zh: 将其技能转移到评估患有精神健康状况的飞行员上来。

sentences.en: A HIMSS neuropsychologist put Merritt through a series of assessments, including a computerized cognitive screening exam designed to test whether he could meet the mental demands
sentences.zh: 一名 HIMSS 神经心理学家让梅里特经历了一系列评估，包括一项旨在测试他是否能满足飞行心理要求的计算机化认知筛查考试

sentences.en: of flying, such as visual and auditory memory and spatial positioning.
sentences.zh: 例如视觉和听觉记忆以及空间定位。

sentences.en: Merritt also had to see a HIMSS psychiatrist, as well as a HIMSS medical examiner who compiled a file for the FAA to review.
sentences.zh: 梅里特还必须去看一名 HIMSS 精神科医生，以及一名 HIMSS 航空体检医生，后者为美国联邦航空管理局的审查整理了一份档案。

sentences.en: Merritt spent more than $10,000 for these medical evaluations, which weren't covered by insurance, and on the travel costs needed to get to them.
sentences.zh: 梅里特为这些不在保险报销范围内的医疗评估以及前往评估所需的差旅费用花费了超过1万美元。

sentences.en: Then Merritt waited.
sentences.zh: 然后梅里特等待着。

sentences.en: And waited.
sentences.zh: 继续等待着。

sentences.en: Nine months after his file was sent off to the FAA, and almost 18 months after he started the process, his special issuance medical certificate arrived in the mail.
sentences.zh: 在他的档案被寄往美国联邦航空管理局九个月后，即他开始这一流程近18个月后，他的特许医疗证通过邮件送达了。

sentences.en: He could now begin retraining to fly again,
sentences.zh: 他现在可以开始重新接受飞行训练了，

sentences.en: practicing and testing in a simulator, piloting with an observer in the cockpit.
sentences.zh: 在模拟器中练习和测试，并在驾驶舱内有观察员的情况下飞行。

sentences.en: About a month later, he was back to transporting passengers.
sentences.zh: 大约一个月后，他又开始运送乘客了。

sentences.en: His experience was, in some ways, a best-case scenario.
sentences.zh: 在某些方面，他的经历是最理想的情况。

sentences.en: The very first medication worked, and his dose remained stable.
sentences.zh: 最初的药物就起效了，而且他的剂量保持稳定。

sentences.en: A change in either would have reset the six-month monitoring period.
sentences.zh: 这两者中的任何变动都会重置六个月的监测期。

sentences.en: The FAA hadn't required additional information from him, like pharmacy records or further evaluations, which could have added months to the process.
sentences.zh: 美国联邦航空管理局没有要求他提供额外的信息，比如药房记录或进一步的评估，这些可能会让流程增加几个月的时间。

sentences.en: Because he worked for a major airline, he was paid 50% of his salary while grounded, support that pilots at smaller regional airlines rarely receive.

sentences.en: And against the advice of her therapist, she released the notes from their sessions.

sentences.en: I feel like I brought it upon myself, she says.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这是我自找的，她说。

sentences.zh: 如果梅里特或卡尔像埃默森那样隐瞒他们的心理挣扎，航空体检医生是不大可能发现他们的。

sentences.zh: 美国联邦航空管理局建议这些在初级培训期间接受了三个小时精神健康指导的医生，通过仅仅观察飞行员的外在表现
